<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>discord.utils.remove_markdown(*text*, ***, *ignore_links=True*)<a href="#discord.utils.remove_markdown" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A helper function that removes markdown characters.

New in version 1.7.

Note

This function is not markdown aware and may remove meaning from the original text. For example, if the input contains <code>10 * 5</code> then it will be converted into <code>10  5</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **text** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The text to remove markdown from.
- **ignore\_links** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to leave links alone when removing markdown. For example, if a URL in the text contains characters such as <code>_</code> then it will be left alone. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The text with the markdown special characters removed.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>discord.utils.escape_markdown(*text*, ***, *as_needed=False*, *ignore_links=True*)<a href="#discord.utils.escape_markdown" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A helper function that escapes Discord’s markdown.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **text** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The text to escape markdown from.
- **as\_needed** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to escape the markdown characters as needed. This means that it does not escape extraneous characters if it’s not necessary, e.g. <code>**hello**</code> is escaped into <code>\*\*hello**</code> instead of <code>\*\*hello\*\*</code>. Note however that this can open you up to some clever syntax abuse. Defaults to <code>False</code>.
- **ignore\_links** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to leave links alone when escaping markdown. For example, if a URL in the text contains characters such as <code>_</code> then it will be left alone. This option is not supported with <code>as_needed</code>. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The text with the markdown special characters escaped with a slash.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>discord.utils.escape_mentions(*text*)<a href="#discord.utils.escape_mentions" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A helper function that escapes everyone, here, role, and user mentions.

Note

This does not include channel mentions.

Note

For more granular control over what mentions should be escaped within messages, refer to the <a href="#discord.AllowedMentions" title="discord.AllowedMentions"><code>AllowedMentions</code></a> class.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

**text** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The text to escape mentions from.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The text with the mentions removed.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>

</dl><dl><dt>*await* discord.utils.sleep_until(*when*, *result=None*)<a href="#discord.utils.sleep_until" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Sleep until a specified time.

If the time supplied is in the past this function will yield instantly.

New in version 1.3.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **when** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>datetime.datetime</code></a>) – The timestamp in which to sleep until. If the datetime is naive then it is assumed to be local time.
- **result** (*Any*) – If provided is returned to the caller when the coroutine completes.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>discord.utils.utcnow()<a href="#discord.utils.utcnow" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A helper function to return an aware UTC datetime representing the current time.

This should be preferred to <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime.utcnow" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>datetime.datetime.utcnow()</code></a> since it is an aware datetime, compared to the naive datetime in the standard library.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The current aware datetime in UTC.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>datetime.datetime</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>discord.utils.format_dt(*dt*, */*, *style=None*)<a href="#discord.utils.format_dt" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A helper function to format a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>datetime.datetime</code></a> for presentation within Discord.

This allows for a locale-independent way of presenting data using Discord specific Markdown.

| Style | Example Output | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| t | 22:57 | Short Time |
| T | 22:57:58 | Medium Time |
| d | 17/05/2016 | Short Date |
| D | May 17, 2016 | Long Date |
| f (default) | May 17, 2016 at 22:57 | Long Date, Short Time |
| F | Tuesday, May 17, 2016 at 22:57 | Full Date, Short Time |
| s | 17/05/2016, 22:57 | Short Date, Short Time |
| S | 17/05/2016, 22:57:58 | Short Date, Medium Time |
| R | 5 years ago | Relative Time |

Note that the exact output depends on the user’s locale setting in the client. The example output presented is using the <code>en-GB</code> locale.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **dt** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>datetime.datetime</code></a>) – The datetime to format.
- **style** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The style to format the datetime with.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The formatted string.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>discord.utils.as_chunks(*iterator*, *max_size*)<a href="#discord.utils.as_chunks" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A helper function that collects an iterator into chunks of a given size.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **iterator** (Union\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.abc.html#collections.abc.Iterable" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>collections.abc.Iterable</code></a>, <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.abc.html#collections.abc.AsyncIterable" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>collections.abc.AsyncIterable</code></a>]) – The iterator to chunk, can be sync or async.
- **max\_size** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The maximum chunk size.

</dd></dl>

Warning

The last chunk collected may not be as large as <code>max_size</code>.

<dl><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

A new iterator which yields chunks of a given size.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

Union\[<code>Iterator</code>, <code>AsyncIterator</code>]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>discord.utils.MISSING<a href="#discord.utils.MISSING" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A type safe sentinel used in the library to represent something as missing. Used to distinguish from <code>None</code> values.

New in version 2.0.

</dd></dl>

## Enumerations ¶

The API provides some enumerations for certain types of strings to avoid the API from being stringly typed in case the strings change in the future.

All enumerations are subclasses of an internal class which mimics the behaviour of [`enum.Enum`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/enum.html#enum.Enum "(in Python v3.14)").

</dd></dl><dl><dt>premium_promo_dismissed<a href="#discord.UserFlags.premium_promo_dismissed" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user has dismissed the Discord Nitro promotion.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>hypesquad_bravery<a href="#discord.UserFlags.hypesquad_bravery" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is a HypeSquad Bravery member.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>hypesquad_brilliance<a href="#discord.UserFlags.hypesquad_brilliance" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is a HypeSquad Brilliance member.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>hypesquad_balance<a href="#discord.UserFlags.hypesquad_balance" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is a HypeSquad Balance member.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>early_supporter<a href="#discord.UserFlags.early_supporter" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is an Early Supporter.

The user is a Team User.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>system<a href="#discord.UserFlags.system" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

The user is a system user (i.e. represents Discord officially).

</dd></dl><dl><dt>has_unread_urgent_messages<a href="#discord.UserFlags.has_unread_urgent_messages" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user has an unread system message.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>bug_hunter_level_2<a href="#discord.UserFlags.bug_hunter_level_2" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is a Bug Hunter Level 2.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>verified_bot<a href="#discord.UserFlags.verified_bot" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

The user is a Verified Bot.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>verified_bot_developer<a href="#discord.UserFlags.verified_bot_developer" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is an Early Verified Bot Developer.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>discord_certified_moderator<a href="#discord.UserFlags.discord_certified_moderator" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is a Moderator Programs Alumni.

<dd>

The user is a bot that only uses HTTP interactions and is shown in the online member list.

New in version 2.0.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>spammer<a href="#discord.UserFlags.spammer" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is flagged as a spammer by Discord.

New in version 2.0.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>active_developer<a href="#discord.UserFlags.active_developer" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The user is an active developer.

New in version 2.1.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.ActivityType<a href="#discord.ActivityType" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Specifies the type of <a href="#discord.Activity" title="discord.Activity"><code>Activity</code></a>. This is used to check how to interpret the activity itself.

<dl><dt>unknown<a href="#discord.ActivityType.unknown" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An unknown activity type. This should generally not happen.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>playing<a href="#discord.ActivityType.playing" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A “Playing” activity type.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>streaming<a href="#discord.ActivityType.streaming" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A “Streaming” activity type.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>listening<a href="#discord.ActivityType.listening" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A “Listening” activity type.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>watching<a href="#discord.ActivityType.watching" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A “Watching” activity type.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>custom<a href="#discord.ActivityType.custom" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A custom activity type.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>competing<a href="#discord.ActivityType.competing" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A competing activity type.

New in version 1.5.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.VerificationLevel<a href="#discord.VerificationLevel" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Specifies a <a href="#discord.Guild" title="discord.Guild"><code>Guild</code></a>'s verification level, which is the criteria in which a member must meet before being able to send messages to the guild.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two verification levels are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two verification levels are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a verification level is higher than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a verification level is lower than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a verification level is higher or equal to another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a verification level is lower or equal to another.

</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>none<a href="#discord.VerificationLevel.none" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

No criteria set.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>low<a href="#discord.VerificationLevel.low" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Member must have a verified email on their Discord account.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>medium<a href="#discord.VerificationLevel.medium" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Member must have a verified email and be registered on Discord for more than five minutes.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>high<a href="#discord.VerificationLevel.high" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Member must have a verified email, be registered on Discord for more than five minutes, and be a member of the guild itself for more than ten minutes.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>highest<a href="#discord.VerificationLevel.highest" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Member must have a verified phone on their Discord account.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.NotificationLevel<a href="#discord.NotificationLevel" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Specifies whether a <a href="#discord.Guild" title="discord.Guild"><code>Guild</code></a> has notifications on for all messages or mentions only by default.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two notification levels are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two notification levels are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a notification level is higher than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a notification level is lower than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a notification level is higher or equal to another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a notification level is lower or equal to another.

</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>all_messages<a href="#discord.NotificationLevel.all_messages" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Members receive notifications for every message regardless of them being mentioned.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>only_mentions<a href="#discord.NotificationLevel.only_mentions" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Members receive notifications for messages they are mentioned in.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.ContentFilter<a href="#discord.ContentFilter" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Specifies a <a href="#discord.Guild" title="discord.Guild"><code>Guild</code></a>'s explicit content filter, which is the machine learning algorithms that Discord uses to detect if an image contains pornography or otherwise explicit content.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two content filter levels are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two content filter levels are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a content filter level is higher than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a content filter level is lower than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a content filter level is higher or equal to another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a content filter level is lower or equal to another.

</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>disabled<a href="#discord.ContentFilter.disabled" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild does not have the content filter enabled.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>no_role<a href="#discord.ContentFilter.no_role" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild has the content filter enabled for members without a role.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>all_members<a href="#discord.ContentFilter.all_members" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild has the content filter enabled for every member.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.Status<a href="#discord.Status" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Specifies a <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a> ‘s status.

<dl><dt>online<a href="#discord.Status.online" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The member is online.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>offline<a href="#discord.Status.offline" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The member is offline.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>idle<a href="#discord.Status.idle" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The member is idle.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>dnd<a href="#discord.Status.dnd" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The member is “Do Not Disturb”.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>do_not_disturb<a href="#discord.Status.do_not_disturb" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An alias for <a href="#discord.Status.dnd" title="discord.Status.dnd"><code>dnd</code></a>.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>invisible<a href="#discord.Status.invisible" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The member is “invisible”. In reality, this is only used when sending a presence a la <a href="#discord.Client.change_presence" title="discord.Client.change_presence"><code>Client.change_presence()</code></a>. When you receive a user’s presence this will be <a href="#discord.Status.offline" title="discord.Status.offline"><code>offline</code></a> instead.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.AuditLogAction<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents the type of action being done for a <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry" title="discord.AuditLogEntry"><code>AuditLogEntry</code></a>, which is retrievable via <a href="#discord.Guild.audit_logs" title="discord.Guild.audit_logs"><code>Guild.audit_logs()</code></a>.

<dl><dt>guild_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.guild_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild has updated. Things that trigger this include:

- Changing the guild vanity URL
- Changing the guild invite splash
- Changing the guild AFK channel or timeout
- Changing the guild voice server region
- Changing the guild icon, banner, or discovery splash
- Changing the guild moderation settings
- Changing things related to the guild widget

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Guild" title="discord.Guild"><code>Guild</code></a>.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.afk_channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.afk_channel"><code>afk_channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.system_channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.system_channel"><code>system_channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.afk_timeout" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.afk_timeout"><code>afk_timeout</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.default_notifications" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.default_notifications"><code>default_notifications</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.explicit_content_filter" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.explicit_content_filter"><code>explicit_content_filter</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.mfa_level" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.mfa_level"><code>mfa_level</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.owner" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.owner"><code>owner</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.splash" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.splash"><code>splash</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.discovery_splash" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.discovery_splash"><code>discovery_splash</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.icon" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.icon"><code>icon</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.banner" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.banner"><code>banner</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.vanity_url_code" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.vanity_url_code"><code>vanity_url_code</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.description" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.description"><code>description</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.preferred_locale" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.preferred_locale"><code>preferred_locale</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.prune_delete_days" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.prune_delete_days"><code>prune_delete_days</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.public_updates_channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.public_updates_channel"><code>public_updates_channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.rules_channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.rules_channel"><code>rules_channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.verification_level" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.verification_level"><code>verification_level</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.widget_channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.widget_channel"><code>widget_channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.widget_enabled" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.widget_enabled"><code>widget_enabled</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.premium_progress_bar_enabled" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.premium_progress_bar_enabled"><code>premium_progress_bar_enabled</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.system_channel_flags" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.system_channel_flags"><code>system_channel_flags</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>channel_create<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.channel_create" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A new channel was created.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is either a <a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel" title="discord.abc.GuildChannel"><code>abc.GuildChannel</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with an ID.

A more filled out object in the <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> case can be found by using <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.after" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.after"><code>after</code></a>.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.overwrites" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.overwrites"><code>overwrites</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>channel_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.channel_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A channel was updated. Things that trigger this include:

- The channel name or topic was changed
- The channel bitrate was changed

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel" title="discord.abc.GuildChannel"><code>abc.GuildChannel</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with an ID.

A more filled out object in the <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> case can be found by using <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.after" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.after"><code>after</code></a> or <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.before" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.before"><code>before</code></a>.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.position" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.position"><code>position</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.overwrites" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.overwrites"><code>overwrites</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.topic" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.topic"><code>topic</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.bitrate" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.bitrate"><code>bitrate</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.rtc_region" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.rtc_region"><code>rtc_region</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.video_quality_mode" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.video_quality_mode"><code>video_quality_mode</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.default_auto_archive_duration" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.default_auto_archive_duration"><code>default_auto_archive_duration</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.nsfw" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.nsfw"><code>nsfw</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.slowmode_delay" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.slowmode_delay"><code>slowmode_delay</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.user_limit" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.user_limit"><code>user_limit</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>channel_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.channel_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A channel was deleted.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is an <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with an ID.

A more filled out object can be found by using the <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.before" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.before"><code>before</code></a> object.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.overwrites" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.overwrites"><code>overwrites</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.flags" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.flags"><code>flags</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.nsfw" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.nsfw"><code>nsfw</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.slowmode_delay" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.slowmode_delay"><code>slowmode_delay</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>overwrite_create<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.overwrite_create" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A channel permission overwrite was created.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel" title="discord.abc.GuildChannel"><code>abc.GuildChannel</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with an ID.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is either a <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>. If the object is not found then it is a <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with an ID being filled, a name, and a <code>type</code> attribute set to either <code>'role'</code> or <code>'member'</code> to help dictate what type of ID it is.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.deny" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.deny"><code>deny</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.allow" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.allow"><code>allow</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.id" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.id"><code>id</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>overwrite_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.overwrite_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A channel permission overwrite was changed, this is typically when the permission values change.

See <a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.overwrite_create" title="discord.AuditLogAction.overwrite_create"><code>overwrite_create</code></a> for more information on how the <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> and <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> fields are set.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.deny" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.deny"><code>deny</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.allow" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.allow"><code>allow</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.id" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.id"><code>id</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>overwrite_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.overwrite_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A channel permission overwrite was deleted.

See <a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.overwrite_create" title="discord.AuditLogAction.overwrite_create"><code>overwrite_create</code></a> for more information on how the <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> and <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> fields are set.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.deny" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.deny"><code>deny</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.allow" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.allow"><code>allow</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.id" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.id"><code>id</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>kick<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.kick" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member was kicked.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who got kicked.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with one attribute:

- <code>integration_type</code>: An optional string that denotes the type of integration that did the action.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>changes</code></a> is empty.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>member_prune<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.member_prune" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member prune was triggered.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is set to <code>None</code>.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with two attributes:

- <code>delete_member_days</code>: An integer specifying how far the prune was.
- <code>members_removed</code>: An integer specifying how many members were removed.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>changes</code></a> is empty.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>ban<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.ban" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member was banned.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who got banned.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>changes</code></a> is empty.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>unban<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.unban" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member was unbanned.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who got unbanned.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>changes</code></a> is empty.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>member_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.member_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member has updated. This triggers in the following situations:

- A nickname was changed
- They were server muted or deafened (or it was undo’d)

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a>, or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who got updated.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.nick" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.nick"><code>nick</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.mute" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.mute"><code>mute</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.deaf" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.deaf"><code>deaf</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.timed_out_until" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.timed_out_until"><code>timed_out_until</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>member_role_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.member_role_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member’s role has been updated. This triggers when a member either gains a role or loses a role.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a>, or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who got the role.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with one attribute:

- <code>integration_type</code>: An optional string that denotes the type of integration that did the action.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.roles" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.roles"><code>roles</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>member_move<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.member_move" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member’s voice channel has been updated. This triggers when a member is moved to a different voice channel.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with two attributes:

- <code>channel</code>: An <a href="#discord.abc.Connectable" title="discord.abc.Connectable"><code>abc.Connectable</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the channel ID where the members were moved.
- <code>count</code>: An integer specifying how many members were moved.

New in version 1.3.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>member_disconnect<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.member_disconnect" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A member’s voice state has changed. This triggers when a member is force disconnected from voice.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with one attribute:

- <code>count</code>: An integer specifying how many members were disconnected.

New in version 1.3.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>bot_add<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.bot_add" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A bot was added to the guild.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a>, or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> which was added to the guild.

New in version 1.3.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>role_create<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.role_create" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A new role was created.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a> or a <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.colour"><code>colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.secondary_colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.secondary_colour"><code>secondary_colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.tertiary_colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.tertiary_colour"><code>tertiary_colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.mentionable" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.mentionable"><code>mentionable</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.hoist" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.hoist"><code>hoist</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.icon" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.icon"><code>icon</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.unicode_emoji" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.unicode_emoji"><code>unicode_emoji</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.permissions" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.permissions"><code>permissions</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>role_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.role_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A role was updated. This triggers in the following situations:

- The name has changed
- The permissions have changed
- The colour has changed
- The role icon (or unicode emoji) has changed
- Its hoist/mentionable state has changed

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a> or a <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.colour"><code>colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.secondary_colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.secondary_colour"><code>secondary_colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.tertiary_colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.tertiary_colour"><code>tertiary_colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.mentionable" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.mentionable"><code>mentionable</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.hoist" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.hoist"><code>hoist</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.icon" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.icon"><code>icon</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.unicode_emoji" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.unicode_emoji"><code>unicode_emoji</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.permissions" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.permissions"><code>permissions</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>role_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.role_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A role was deleted.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a> or a <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.colour"><code>colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.secondary_colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.secondary_colour"><code>secondary_colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.tertiary_colour" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.tertiary_colour"><code>tertiary_colour</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.mentionable" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.mentionable"><code>mentionable</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.hoist" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.hoist"><code>hoist</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.permissions" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.permissions"><code>permissions</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>invite_create<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.invite_create" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An invite was created.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Invite" title="discord.Invite"><code>Invite</code></a> that was created.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.temporary" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.temporary"><code>temporary</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.inviter" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.inviter"><code>inviter</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.channel"><code>channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.uses" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.uses"><code>uses</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.max_uses" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.max_uses"><code>max_uses</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.flags" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.flags"><code>flags</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>invite_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.invite_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An invite was updated.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Invite" title="discord.Invite"><code>Invite</code></a> that was updated.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>invite_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.invite_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An invite was deleted.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Invite" title="discord.Invite"><code>Invite</code></a> that was deleted.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.max_age" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.max_age"><code>max_age</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.code" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.code"><code>code</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.temporary" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.temporary"><code>temporary</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.inviter" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.inviter"><code>inviter</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.channel"><code>channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.uses" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.uses"><code>uses</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.max_uses" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.max_uses"><code>max_uses</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.flags" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.flags"><code>flags</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>webhook_create<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.webhook_create" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A webhook was created.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the webhook ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.channel"><code>channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a> (always set to <code>1</code> if so)

</dd></dl><dl><dt>webhook_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.webhook_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A webhook was updated. This trigger in the following situations:

- The webhook name changed
- The webhook channel changed

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the webhook ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.channel"><code>channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.avatar" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.avatar"><code>avatar</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>webhook_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.webhook_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A webhook was deleted.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the webhook ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.channel" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.channel"><code>channel</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>
- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.type" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.type"><code>type</code></a> (always set to <code>1</code> if so)

</dd></dl><dl><dt>emoji_create<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.emoji_create" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An emoji was created.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Emoji" title="discord.Emoji"><code>Emoji</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the emoji ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>emoji_update<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.emoji_update" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An emoji was updated. This triggers when the name has changed.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Emoji" title="discord.Emoji"><code>Emoji</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the emoji ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>emoji_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.emoji_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An emoji was deleted.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the emoji ID.

Possible attributes for <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>:

- <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff.name" title="discord.AuditLogDiff.name"><code>name</code></a>

</dd></dl><dl><dt>message_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.message_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A message was deleted by a moderator. Note that this only triggers if the message was deleted by someone other than the author.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a>, or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who had their message deleted.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with two attributes:

- <code>count</code>: An integer specifying how many messages were deleted.
- <code>channel</code>: A <a href="#discord.TextChannel" title="discord.TextChannel"><code>TextChannel</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the channel ID where the message got deleted.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>message_bulk_delete<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.message_bulk_delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Messages were bulk deleted by a moderator.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.TextChannel" title="discord.TextChannel"><code>TextChannel</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the ID of the channel that was purged.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with one attribute:

- <code>count</code>: An integer specifying how many messages were deleted.

New in version 1.3.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>message_pin<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.message_pin" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A message was pinned in a channel.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a>, or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who had their message pinned.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with two attributes:

- <code>channel</code>: A <a href="#discord.TextChannel" title="discord.TextChannel"><code>TextChannel</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the channel ID where the message was pinned.
- <code>message_id</code>: the ID of the message which was pinned.

New in version 1.3.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>message_unpin<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.message_unpin" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A message was unpinned in a channel.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is the <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.User" title="discord.User"><code>User</code></a>, or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> who had their message unpinned.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with two attributes:

- <code>channel</code>: A <a href="#discord.TextChannel" title="discord.TextChannel"><code>TextChannel</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Object" title="discord.Object"><code>Object</code></a> with the channel ID where the message was unpinned.
- <code>message_id</code>: the ID of the message which was unpinned.

New in version 1.3.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>integration_create<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.integration_create" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

- <code>channel</code>: The channel in which the automod rule was triggered.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>AuditLogEntry.changes</code></a> is empty.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>AuditLogEntry.changes</code></a> is empty.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>automod_timeout_member<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.automod_timeout_member" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An automod rule timed-out a member.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is a <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a> with the ID of the person who triggered the automod rule.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with 3 attributes:

- <code>automod_rule_name</code>: The name of the automod rule that was triggered.
- <code>automod_rule_trigger_type</code>: A <a href="#discord.AutoModRuleTriggerType" title="discord.AutoModRuleTriggerType"><code>AutoModRuleTriggerType</code></a> representation of the rule type that was triggered.
- <code>channel</code>: The channel in which the automod rule was triggered.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>AuditLogEntry.changes</code></a> is empty.

New in version 2.1.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>automod_quarantine_user<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.automod_quarantine_user" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An automod rule quarantined a member.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.target" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.target"><code>target</code></a> is a <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a> with the ID of the person who triggered the automod rule.

When this is the action, the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.extra" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.extra"><code>extra</code></a> is set to an unspecified proxy object with 3 attributes:

- <code>automod_rule_name</code>: The name of the automod rule that was triggered.
- <code>automod_rule_trigger_type</code>: A <a href="#discord.AutoModRuleTriggerType" title="discord.AutoModRuleTriggerType"><code>AutoModRuleTriggerType</code></a> representation of the rule type that was triggered.
- <code>channel</code>: The channel of the message sent by the member when they were flagged. *None* if the member was quarantined when they just joined the guild.

When this is the action, <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.changes" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.changes"><code>AuditLogEntry.changes</code></a> is empty.

New in version 2.6.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>creator_monetization_request_created<a href="#discord.AuditLogAction.creator_monetization_request_created" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

New in version 1.3.

<dl><dt>invited<a href="#discord.TeamMembershipState.invited" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents an invited member.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>accepted<a href="#discord.TeamMembershipState.accepted" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents a member currently in the team.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.TeamMemberRole<a href="#discord.TeamMemberRole" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents the type of role of a team member retrieved through <a href="#discord.Client.application_info" title="discord.Client.application_info"><code>Client.application_info()</code></a>.

New in version 2.4.

<dl><dt>admin<a href="#discord.TeamMemberRole.admin" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The team member is an admin. This allows them to invite members to the team, access credentials, edit the application, and do most things the owner can do. However they cannot do destructive actions.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>developer<a href="#discord.TeamMemberRole.developer" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The team member is a developer. This allows them to access information, like the client secret or public key. They can also configure interaction endpoints or reset the bot token. Developers cannot invite anyone to the team nor can they do destructive actions.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>read_only<a href="#discord.TeamMemberRole.read_only" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The team member is a read-only member. This allows them to access information, but not edit anything.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.WebhookType<a href="#discord.WebhookType" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.NSFWLevel<a href="#discord.NSFWLevel" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents the NSFW level of a guild.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two NSFW levels are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two NSFW levels are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a NSFW level is higher than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a NSFW level is lower than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a NSFW level is higher or equal to another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a NSFW level is lower or equal to another.

</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>default<a href="#discord.NSFWLevel.default" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild has not been categorised yet.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>explicit<a href="#discord.NSFWLevel.explicit" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild contains NSFW content.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>safe<a href="#discord.NSFWLevel.safe" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild does not contain any NSFW content.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>age_restricted<a href="#discord.NSFWLevel.age_restricted" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild may contain NSFW content.

</dd></dl></dd>

</dl><dl><dt>*class*discord.MFALevel<a href="#discord.MFALevel" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two MFA levels are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two MFA levels are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a MFA level is higher than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt; y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a MFA level is lower than another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &gt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a MFA level is higher or equal to another.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x &lt;= y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if a MFA level is lower or equal to another.

</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>disabled<a href="#discord.MFALevel.disabled" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild has no MFA requirement.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>require_2fa<a href="#discord.MFALevel.require_2fa" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

</dd></dl></dd>

## Audit Log Data ¶

Working with [`Guild.audit_logs()`](#discord.Guild.audit_logs "discord.Guild.audit_logs") is a complicated process with a lot of machinery involved. The library attempts to make it easy to use and friendly. In order to accomplish this goal, it must make use of a couple of data classes that aid in this goal.

<dl><dt>*class*discord.AuditLogEntry(***, *users*, *integrations*, *app_commands*, *automod_rules*, *webhooks*, *data*, *guild*)<a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents an Audit Log entry.

You retrieve these via <a href="#discord.Guild.audit_logs" title="discord.Guild.audit_logs"><code>Guild.audit_logs()</code></a>.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two entries are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two entries are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>hash(x)</dt>
<dd>

Returns the entry’s hash.

</dd></dl>

Changed in version 1.7: Audit log entries are now comparable and hashable.

### AuditLogChanges ¶

Attributes

- [after](#discord.AuditLogChanges.after)
- [before](#discord.AuditLogChanges.before)

<dl><dt>*class*discord.AuditLogChanges<a href="#discord.AuditLogChanges" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

An audit log change set.

<dl><dt>before<a href="#discord.AuditLogChanges.before" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The old value. The attribute has the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>.

Depending on the <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory"><code>AuditLogActionCategory</code></a> retrieved by <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.category" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.category"><code>category</code></a>, the data retrieved by this attribute differs:

| Category | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory.create" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory.create"><code>create</code></a> | All attributes are set to <code>None</code>. |
| <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory.delete" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory.delete"><code>delete</code></a> | All attributes are set the value before deletion. |
| <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory.update" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory.update"><code>update</code></a> | All attributes are set the value before updating. |
| <code>None</code> | No attributes are set. |

</dd></dl><dl><dt>after<a href="#discord.AuditLogChanges.after" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The new value. The attribute has the type of <a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="discord.AuditLogDiff"><code>AuditLogDiff</code></a>.

Depending on the <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory"><code>AuditLogActionCategory</code></a> retrieved by <a href="#discord.AuditLogEntry.category" title="discord.AuditLogEntry.category"><code>category</code></a>, the data retrieved by this attribute differs:

| Category | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory.create" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory.create"><code>create</code></a> | All attributes are set to the created value |
| <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory.delete" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory.delete"><code>delete</code></a> | All attributes are set to <code>None</code> |
| <a href="#discord.AuditLogActionCategory.update" title="discord.AuditLogActionCategory.update"><code>update</code></a> | All attributes are set the value after updating. |
| <code>None</code> | No attributes are set. |

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl>

<dl><dt>*class*discord.AuditLogDiff<a href="#discord.AuditLogDiff" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents an audit log “change” object. A change object has dynamic attributes that depend on the type of action being done. Certain actions map to certain attributes being set.

Note that accessing an attribute that does not match the specified action will lead to an attribute error.

To get a list of attributes that have been set, you can iterate over them. To see a list of all possible attributes that could be set based on the action being done, check the documentation for <a href="#discord.AuditLogAction" title="discord.AuditLogAction"><code>AuditLogAction</code></a>, otherwise check the documentation below for all attributes that are possible.

<dl><dt>iter(diff)</dt>
<dd>

Returns an iterator over (attribute, value) tuple of this diff.

</dd></dl>

## Webhook Support ¶

discord.py offers support for creating, editing, and executing webhooks through the [`Webhook`](#discord.Webhook "discord.Webhook") class.

### Webhook ¶

Attributes

- [avatar](#discord.Webhook.avatar)
- [channel](#discord.Webhook.channel)
- [channel\_id](#discord.Webhook.channel_id)
- [created\_at](#discord.Webhook.created_at)
- [default\_avatar](#discord.Webhook.default_avatar)
- [display\_avatar](#discord.Webhook.display_avatar)
- [guild](#discord.Webhook.guild)
- [guild\_id](#discord.Webhook.guild_id)
- [id](#discord.Webhook.id)
- [name](#discord.Webhook.name)
- [source\_channel](#discord.Webhook.source_channel)
- [source\_guild](#discord.Webhook.source_guild)

Methods

<dl><dt>*class*discord.Webhook<a href="#discord.Webhook" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents an asynchronous Discord webhook.

Webhooks are a form to send messages to channels in Discord without a bot user or authentication.

There are two main ways to use Webhooks. The first is through the ones received by the library such as <a href="#discord.Guild.webhooks" title="discord.Guild.webhooks"><code>Guild.webhooks()</code></a>, <a href="#discord.TextChannel.webhooks" title="discord.TextChannel.webhooks"><code>TextChannel.webhooks()</code></a>, <a href="#discord.VoiceChannel.webhooks" title="discord.VoiceChannel.webhooks"><code>VoiceChannel.webhooks()</code></a> and <a href="#discord.ForumChannel.webhooks" title="discord.ForumChannel.webhooks"><code>ForumChannel.webhooks()</code></a>. The ones received by the library will automatically be bound using the library’s internal HTTP session.

The second form involves creating a webhook object manually using the <a href="#discord.Webhook.from_url" title="discord.Webhook.from_url"><code>from_url()</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Webhook.partial" title="discord.Webhook.partial"><code>partial()</code></a> classmethods.

For example, creating a webhook from a URL and using <a href="https://docs.aiohttp.org/en/stable/index.html" title="(in aiohttp v3.13)">aiohttp</a>:

```
from discord import Webhook
import aiohttp

async def foo():
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        webhook = Webhook.from_url('url-here', session=session)
        await webhook.send('Hello World', username='Foo')

```

For a synchronous counterpart, see <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a>.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two webhooks are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two webhooks are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>hash(x)</dt>
<dd>

Returns the webhooks’s hash.

</dd></dl>

Changed in version 1.4: Webhooks are now comparable and hashable.

</dl><dl><dt>*classmethod* partial(*id*, *token*, ***, *session=...*, *client=...*, *bot_token=None*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.partial" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Creates a partial <a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **id** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The ID of the webhook.
- **token** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The authentication token of the webhook.
- **session** (<a href="https://docs.aiohttp.org/en/stable/client_reference.html#aiohttp.ClientSession" title="(in aiohttp v3.13)"><code>aiohttp.ClientSession</code></a>) –

  The session to use to send requests with. Note that the library does not manage the session and will not close it.

  New in version 2.0.
- **client** (<a href="#discord.Client" title="discord.Client"><code>Client</code></a>) –

  The client to initialise this webhook with. This allows it to attach the client’s internal state. If <code>session</code> is not given while this is given then the client’s internal session will be used.

  New in version 2.2.
- **bot\_token** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) –

  The bot authentication token for authenticated requests involving the webhook.

  New in version 2.0.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – Neither <code>session</code> nor <code>client</code> were given.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

A partial <a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>. A partial webhook is just a webhook object with an ID and a token.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*classmethod* from_url(*url*, ***, *session=...*, *client=...*, *bot_token=None*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.from_url" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Creates a partial <a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a> from a webhook URL.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **url** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The URL of the webhook.
- **session** (<a href="https://docs.aiohttp.org/en/stable/client_reference.html#aiohttp.ClientSession" title="(in aiohttp v3.13)"><code>aiohttp.ClientSession</code></a>) –

  The session to use to send requests with. Note that the library does not manage the session and will not close it.

  New in version 2.0.
- **client** (<a href="#discord.Client" title="discord.Client"><code>Client</code></a>) –

  New in version 2.2.
- **bot\_token** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) –

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

A partial <a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>. A partial webhook is just a webhook object with an ID and a token.

<a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* fetch(***, *prefer_auth=True*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.fetch" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Fetches the current webhook.

This could be used to get a full webhook from a partial webhook.

New in version 2.0.

Note

When fetching with an unauthenticated webhook, i.e. <a href="#discord.Webhook.is_authenticated" title="discord.Webhook.is_authenticated"><code>is_authenticated()</code></a> returns <code>False</code>, then the returned webhook does not contain any user information.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

**prefer\_auth** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to use the bot token over the webhook token if available. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Could not fetch the webhook
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – Could not find the webhook by this ID
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This webhook does not have a token associated with it.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The fetched webhook.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* delete(***, *reason=None*, *prefer_auth=True*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Deletes this Webhook.

<dd>

- **reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) –

  The reason for deleting this webhook. Shows up on the audit log.

  New in version 1.4.
- **prefer\_auth** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

  Whether to use the bot token over the webhook token if available. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

  New in version 2.0.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Deleting the webhook failed.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – This webhook does not exist.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have permissions to delete this webhook.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This webhook does not have a token associated with it.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* edit(***, *reason=None*, *name=...*, *avatar=...*, *channel=None*, *prefer_auth=True*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.edit" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Edits this Webhook.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **name** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The webhook’s new default name.
- **avatar** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#bytes" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bytes</code></a>]) – A <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/glossary.html#term-bytes-like-object" title="(in Python v3.14)">bytes-like object</a> representing the webhook’s new default avatar.
- **channel** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>abc.Snowflake</code></a>]) –

  The webhook’s new channel. This requires an authenticated webhook.

  New in version 2.0.
- **reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) –

  The reason for editing this webhook. Shows up on the audit log.

  New in version 1.4.
- **prefer\_auth** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

  Whether to use the bot token over the webhook token if available. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

  New in version 2.0.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Editing the webhook failed.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – This webhook does not exist.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This webhook does not have a token associated with it or it tried editing a channel without authentication.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*avatar<a href="#discord.Webhook.avatar" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

</dl><dl><dt>*property*guild<a href="#discord.Webhook.guild" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>is_authenticated()<a href="#discord.Webhook.is_authenticated" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>: Whether the webhook is authenticated with a bot token.
