</dd></dl><dl><dt>is_partial()<a href="#discord.Webhook.is_partial" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>: Whether the webhook is a “partial” webhook.

New in version 2.0.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>*await* send(*content=...*, ***, *username=...*, *avatar_url=...*, *tts=False*, *ephemeral=False*, *file=...*, *files=...*, *embed=...*, *embeds=...*, *allowed_mentions=...*, *view=...*, *thread=...*, *thread_name=...*, *wait=False*, *suppress_embeds=False*, *silent=False*, *applied_tags=...*, *poll=...*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.send" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Sends a message using the webhook.

The content must be a type that can convert to a string through <code>str(content)</code>.

To upload a single file, the <code>file</code> parameter should be used with a single <a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a> object.

If the <code>embed</code> parameter is provided, it must be of type <a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a> and it must be a rich embed type. You cannot mix the <code>embed</code> parameter with the <code>embeds</code> parameter, which must be a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#list" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>list</code></a> of <a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a> objects to send.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **content** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The content of the message to send.
- **wait** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether the server should wait before sending a response. This essentially means that the return type of this function changes from <code>None</code> to a <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage" title="discord.WebhookMessage"><code>WebhookMessage</code></a> if set to <code>True</code>. If the type of webhook is <a href="#discord.WebhookType.application" title="discord.WebhookType.application"><code>WebhookType.application</code></a> then this is always set to <code>True</code>.
- **username** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The username to send with this message. If no username is provided then the default username for the webhook is used.
- **avatar\_url** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The avatar URL to send with this message. If no avatar URL is provided then the default avatar for the webhook is used. If this is not a string then it is explicitly cast using <code>str</code>.
- **tts** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Indicates if the message should be sent using text-to-speech.
- **ephemeral** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

  Indicates if the message should only be visible to the user. This is only available to <a href="#discord.WebhookType.application" title="discord.WebhookType.application"><code>WebhookType.application</code></a> webhooks. If a view is sent with an ephemeral message and it has no timeout set then the timeout is set to 15 minutes.

  New in version 2.0.
- **file** (<a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>) – The file to upload. This cannot be mixed with <code>files</code> parameter.
- **files** (List\[<a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>]) – A list of files to send with the content. This cannot be mixed with the <code>file</code> parameter.
- **embed** (<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>) – The rich embed for the content to send. This cannot be mixed with <code>embeds</code> parameter.
- **embeds** (List\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – A list of embeds to send with the content. Maximum of 10. This cannot be mixed with the <code>embed</code> parameter.
- **allowed\_mentions** (<a href="#discord.AllowedMentions" title="discord.AllowedMentions"><code>AllowedMentions</code></a>) –

  Controls the mentions being processed in this message.

  New in version 1.4.
- **view** (Union\[<a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.View" title="discord.ui.View"><code>discord.ui.View</code></a>, <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>discord.ui.LayoutView</code></a>]) –

  The view to send with the message. If the webhook is partial or is not managed by the library, then you can not send interactable components. Otherwise, you can send views with any type of components.

  New in version 2.0.
- **thread** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) –

  The thread to send this webhook to.

  New in version 2.0.
- **thread\_name** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) –

  The thread name to create with this webhook if the webhook belongs to a <a href="#discord.ForumChannel" title="discord.ForumChannel"><code>ForumChannel</code></a>. Note that this is mutually exclusive with the <code>thread</code> parameter, as this will create a new thread with the given name.

  New in version 2.0.
- **suppress\_embeds** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

  Whether to suppress embeds for the message. This sends the message without any embeds if set to <code>True</code>.

  New in version 2.0.
- **silent** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

  Whether to suppress push and desktop notifications for the message. This will increment the mention counter in the UI, but will not actually send a notification.

  New in version 2.2.
- **applied\_tags** (List\[<a href="#discord.ForumTag" title="discord.ForumTag"><code>ForumTag</code></a>]) –

  Tags to apply to the thread if the webhook belongs to a <a href="#discord.ForumChannel" title="discord.ForumChannel"><code>ForumChannel</code></a>.

  New in version 2.4.
- **poll** (<a href="#discord.Poll" title="discord.Poll"><code>Poll</code></a>) –

  The poll to send with this message.

  Warning

  When sending a Poll via webhook, you cannot manually end it.

  New in version 2.4.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Sending the message failed.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – This webhook was not found.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – The authorization token for the webhook is incorrect.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – You specified both <code>embed</code> and <code>embeds</code> or <code>file</code> and <code>files</code> or <code>thread</code> and <code>thread_name</code>.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The length of <code>embeds</code> was invalid, there was no token associated with this webhook or <code>ephemeral</code> was passed with the improper webhook type or there was no state attached with this webhook when giving it a view that had components other than URL buttons.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

If <code>wait</code> is <code>True</code> then the message that was sent, otherwise <code>None</code>.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

Optional\[<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage" title="discord.WebhookMessage"><code>WebhookMessage</code></a>]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* fetch_message(*id*, */*, ***, *thread=...*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.fetch_message" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Retrieves a single <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage" title="discord.WebhookMessage"><code>WebhookMessage</code></a> owned by this webhook.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **id** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The message ID to look for.

</dl><dl><dt>*await* edit_message(*message_id*, ***, *content=...*, *embeds=...*, *embed=...*, *attachments=...*, *view=...*, *allowed_mentions=None*, *thread=...*)<a href="#discord.Webhook.edit_message" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Edits a message owned by this webhook.

This is a lower level interface to <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.edit" title="discord.WebhookMessage.edit"><code>WebhookMessage.edit()</code></a> in case you only have an ID.

New in version 1.6.

Changed in version 2.0: The edit is no longer in-place, instead the newly edited message is returned.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **message\_id** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The message ID to edit.
- **content** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The content to edit the message with or <code>None</code> to clear it.
- **embeds** (List\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – A list of embeds to edit the message with.
- **embed** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – The embed to edit the message with. <code>None</code> suppresses the embeds. This should not be mixed with the <code>embeds</code> parameter.
- **attachments** (List\[Union\[<a href="#discord.Attachment" title="discord.Attachment"><code>Attachment</code></a>, <a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>]]) –

  A list of attachments to keep in the message as well as new files to upload. If <code>[]</code> is passed then all attachments are removed.

  New in version 2.0.
- **allowed\_mentions** (<a href="#discord.AllowedMentions" title="discord.AllowedMentions"><code>AllowedMentions</code></a>) – Controls the mentions being processed in this message. See <a href="#discord.abc.Messageable.send" title="discord.abc.Messageable.send"><code>abc.Messageable.send()</code></a> for more information.
- **view** (Optional\[Union\[<a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.View" title="discord.ui.View"><code>View</code></a>, <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>LayoutView</code></a>]]) –

  The updated view to update this message with. If <code>None</code> is passed then the view is removed. If the webhook is partial or is not managed by the library, then you can not send interactable components. Otherwise, you can send views with any type of components.

  New in version 2.0.
- **thread** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) –

  The thread the webhook message belongs to.

  New in version 2.0.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – Edited a message that is not yours.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – You specified both <code>embed</code> and <code>embeds</code>

<dl><dt>*class*discord.WebhookMessage<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents a message sent from your webhook.

This allows you to edit or delete a message sent by your webhook.

This inherits from <a href="#discord.Message" title="discord.Message"><code>discord.Message</code></a> with changes to <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.edit" title="discord.WebhookMessage.edit"><code>edit()</code></a> and <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.delete" title="discord.WebhookMessage.delete"><code>delete()</code></a> to work.

New in version 1.6.

<dl><dt>*await* edit(***, *content=...*, *embeds=...*, *embed=...*, *attachments=...*, *view=...*, *allowed_mentions=None*)<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.edit" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Edits the message.

New in version 1.6.

Changed in version 2.0: The edit is no longer in-place, instead the newly edited message is returned.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **content** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The content to edit the message with or <code>None</code> to clear it.
- **embeds** (List\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – A list of embeds to edit the message with.
- **embed** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – The embed to edit the message with. <code>None</code> suppresses the embeds. This should not be mixed with the <code>embeds</code> parameter.
- **attachments** (List\[Union\[<a href="#discord.Attachment" title="discord.Attachment"><code>Attachment</code></a>, <a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>]]) –

  A list of attachments to keep in the message as well as new files to upload. If <code>[]</code> is passed then all attachments are removed.

  Note

  New files will always appear after current attachments.

  New in version 2.0.
- **allowed\_mentions** (<a href="#discord.AllowedMentions" title="discord.AllowedMentions"><code>AllowedMentions</code></a>) – Controls the mentions being processed in this message. See <a href="#discord.abc.Messageable.send" title="discord.abc.Messageable.send"><code>abc.Messageable.send()</code></a> for more information.
- **view** (Optional\[<a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.View" title="discord.ui.View"><code>View</code></a>]) –

  The updated view to update this message with. If <code>None</code> is passed then the view is removed. If the webhook is partial or is not managed by the library, then you can not send interactable components. Otherwise, you can send views with any type of components.

  Note

  To update the message to add a <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>LayoutView</code></a>, you must explicitly set the <code>content</code>, <code>embed</code>, <code>embeds</code>, and <code>attachments</code> parameters to either <code>None</code> or an empty array, as appropriate.

  New in version 2.0.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Editing the message failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – Edited a message that is not yours.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – You specified both <code>embed</code> and <code>embeds</code>
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The length of <code>embeds</code> was invalid or there was no token associated with this webhook.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The newly edited message.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage" title="discord.WebhookMessage"><code>WebhookMessage</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>

</dl><dl><dt>*await* add_reaction(*emoji*, */*)<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.add_reaction" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Adds a reaction to the message.

The emoji may be a unicode emoji or a custom guild <a href="#discord.Emoji" title="discord.Emoji"><code>Emoji</code></a>.

You must have <a href="#discord.Permissions.read_message_history" title="discord.Permissions.read_message_history"><code>read_message_history</code></a> to do this. If nobody else has reacted to the message using this emoji, <a href="#discord.Permissions.add_reactions" title="discord.Permissions.add_reactions"><code>add_reactions</code></a> is required.

Changed in version 2.0: <code>emoji</code> parameter is now positional-only.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>TypeError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

**emoji** (Union\[<a href="#discord.Emoji" title="discord.Emoji"><code>Emoji</code></a>, <a href="#discord.Reaction" title="discord.Reaction"><code>Reaction</code></a>, <a href="#discord.PartialEmoji" title="discord.PartialEmoji"><code>PartialEmoji</code></a>, <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The emoji to react with.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Adding the reaction failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have the proper permissions to react to the message.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – The emoji you specified was not found.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – The emoji parameter is invalid.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>clean_content<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.clean_content" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A property that returns the content in a “cleaned up” manner. This basically means that mentions are transformed into the way the client shows it. e.g. <code>&lt;#id&gt;</code> will transform into <code>#name</code>.

This will also transform @everyone and @here mentions into non-mentions.

Note

This *does not* affect markdown. If you want to escape or remove markdown then use <a href="#discord.utils.escape_markdown" title="discord.utils.escape_markdown"><code>utils.escape_markdown()</code></a> or <a href="#discord.utils.remove_markdown" title="discord.utils.remove_markdown"><code>utils.remove_markdown()</code></a> respectively, along with this function.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>TypeError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

**emoji** (Union\[<a href="#discord.Emoji" title="discord.Emoji"><code>Emoji</code></a>, <a href="#discord.Reaction" title="discord.Reaction"><code>Reaction</code></a>, <a href="#discord.PartialEmoji" title="discord.PartialEmoji"><code>PartialEmoji</code></a>, <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The emoji to clear.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Clearing the reaction failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have the proper permissions to clear the reaction.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – The emoji you specified was not found.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – The emoji parameter is invalid.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* clear_reactions()<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.clear_reactions" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* create_thread(***, *name*, *auto_archive_duration=...*, *slowmode_delay=None*, *reason=None*)<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.create_thread" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Creates a public thread from this message.

You must have <a href="#discord.Permissions.create_public_threads" title="discord.Permissions.create_public_threads"><code>create_public_threads</code></a> in order to create a public thread from a message.

The channel this message belongs in must be a <a href="#discord.TextChannel" title="discord.TextChannel"><code>TextChannel</code></a>.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **name** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The name of the thread.
- **auto\_archive\_duration** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) –

  The duration in minutes before a thread is automatically hidden from the channel list. If not provided, the channel’s default auto archive duration is used.

  Must be one of <code>60</code>, <code>1440</code>, <code>4320</code>, or <code>10080</code>, if provided.
- **slowmode\_delay** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>]) – Specifies the slowmode rate limit for user in this channel, in seconds. The maximum value possible is <code>21600</code>. By default no slowmode rate limit if this is <code>None</code>.
- **reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The reason for creating a new thread. Shows up on the audit log.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have permissions to create a thread.
- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Creating the thread failed.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This message does not have guild info attached.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

</dl><dl><dt>*await* remove_reaction(*emoji*, *member*)<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.remove_reaction" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Remove a reaction by the member from the message.

The emoji may be a unicode emoji or a custom guild <a href="#discord.Emoji" title="discord.Emoji"><code>Emoji</code></a>.

If the reaction is not your own (i.e. <code>member</code> parameter is not you) then <a href="#discord.Permissions.manage_messages" title="discord.Permissions.manage_messages"><code>manage_messages</code></a> is needed.

The <code>member</code> parameter must represent a member and meet the <a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>abc.Snowflake</code></a> abc.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>TypeError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **emoji** (Union\[<a href="#discord.Emoji" title="discord.Emoji"><code>Emoji</code></a>, <a href="#discord.Reaction" title="discord.Reaction"><code>Reaction</code></a>, <a href="#discord.PartialEmoji" title="discord.PartialEmoji"><code>PartialEmoji</code></a>, <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The emoji to remove.
- **member** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>abc.Snowflake</code></a>) – The member for which to remove the reaction.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Removing the reaction failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have the proper permissions to remove the reaction.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – The member or emoji you specified was not found.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – The emoji parameter is invalid.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* reply(*content=None*, ***kwargs*)<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.reply" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

A shortcut method to <a href="#discord.abc.Messageable.send" title="discord.abc.Messageable.send"><code>abc.Messageable.send()</code></a> to reply to the <a href="#discord.Message" title="discord.Message"><code>Message</code></a>.

New in version 1.6.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>TypeError</code></a> or <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Sending the message failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have the proper permissions to send the message.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The <code>files</code> list is not of the appropriate size
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – You specified both <code>file</code> and <code>files</code>.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The message that was sent.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.Message" title="discord.Message"><code>Message</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>system_content<a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.system_content" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

A property that returns the content that is rendered regardless of the <a href="#discord.Message.type" title="discord.Message.type"><code>Message.type</code></a>.

<dl><dt>*class*discord.SyncWebhook<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents a synchronous Discord webhook.

For an asynchronous counterpart, see <a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>.

<dl><dt>x == y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two webhooks are equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>x != y</dt>
<dd>

Checks if two webhooks are not equal.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>hash(x)</dt>
<dd>

Returns the webhooks’s hash.

</dd></dl>

Changed in version 1.4: Webhooks are now comparable and hashable.

Only given if <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.type" title="discord.SyncWebhook.type"><code>type</code></a> is <a href="#discord.WebhookType.channel_follower" title="discord.WebhookType.channel_follower"><code>WebhookType.channel_follower</code></a>.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

Optional\[<a href="#discord.PartialWebhookGuild" title="discord.PartialWebhookGuild"><code>PartialWebhookGuild</code></a>]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>source_channel<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.source_channel" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The channel that this webhook is following. Only given if <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.type" title="discord.SyncWebhook.type"><code>type</code></a> is <a href="#discord.WebhookType.channel_follower" title="discord.WebhookType.channel_follower"><code>WebhookType.channel_follower</code></a>.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

Optional\[<a href="#discord.PartialWebhookChannel" title="discord.PartialWebhookChannel"><code>PartialWebhookChannel</code></a>]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*url<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.url" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*classmethod* partial(*id*, *token*, ***, *session=...*, *bot_token=None*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.partial" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Creates a partial <a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **id** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The ID of the webhook.
- **token** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The authentication token of the webhook.
- **session** (<a href="https://requests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/#requests.Session" title="(in Requests v2.33.0.dev1)"><code>requests.Session</code></a>) – The session to use to send requests with. Note that the library does not manage the session and will not close it. If not given, the <code>requests</code> auto session creation functions are used instead.
- **bot\_token** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The bot authentication token for authenticated requests involving the webhook.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

A partial <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a>. A partial <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a> is just a <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a> object with an ID and a token.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*classmethod* from_url(*url*, ***, *session=...*, *bot_token=None*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.from_url" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Creates a partial <a href="#discord.Webhook" title="discord.Webhook"><code>Webhook</code></a> from a webhook URL.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **url** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The URL of the webhook.
- **session** (<a href="https://requests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/#requests.Session" title="(in Requests v2.33.0.dev1)"><code>requests.Session</code></a>) – The session to use to send requests with. Note that the library does not manage the session and will not close it. If not given, the <code>requests</code> auto session creation functions are used instead.
- **bot\_token** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The bot authentication token for authenticated requests involving the webhook.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The URL is invalid.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

A partial <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a>. A partial <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a> is just a <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a> object with an ID and a token.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>fetch(***, *prefer_auth=True*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.fetch" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Fetches the current webhook.

This could be used to get a full webhook from a partial webhook.

Note

When fetching with an unauthenticated webhook, i.e. <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.is_authenticated" title="discord.SyncWebhook.is_authenticated"><code>is_authenticated()</code></a> returns <code>False</code>, then the returned webhook does not contain any user information.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

**prefer\_auth** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to use the bot token over the webhook token if available. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Could not fetch the webhook
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – Could not find the webhook by this ID
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This webhook does not have a token associated with it.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The fetched webhook.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>delete(***, *reason=None*, *prefer_auth=True*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Deletes this Webhook.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) –

  The reason for deleting this webhook. Shows up on the audit log.

  New in version 1.4.
- **prefer\_auth** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to use the bot token over the webhook token if available. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Deleting the webhook failed.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – This webhook does not exist.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have permissions to delete this webhook.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This webhook does not have a token associated with it.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>edit(***, *reason=None*, *name=...*, *avatar=...*, *channel=None*, *prefer_auth=True*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.edit" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Edits this Webhook.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **name** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The webhook’s new default name.
- **avatar** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#bytes" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bytes</code></a>]) – A <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/glossary.html#term-bytes-like-object" title="(in Python v3.14)">bytes-like object</a> representing the webhook’s new default avatar.
- **channel** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>abc.Snowflake</code></a>]) – The webhook’s new channel. This requires an authenticated webhook.
- **reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) –

  The reason for editing this webhook. Shows up on the audit log.

  New in version 1.4.
- **prefer\_auth** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to use the bot token over the webhook token if available. Defaults to <code>True</code>.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Editing the webhook failed.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – This webhook does not exist.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This webhook does not have a token associated with it or it tried editing a channel without authentication.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The newly edited webhook.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook" title="discord.SyncWebhook"><code>SyncWebhook</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*avatar<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.avatar" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Returns an <a href="#discord.Asset" title="discord.Asset"><code>Asset</code></a> for the avatar the webhook has.

If the webhook does not have a traditional avatar, <code>None</code> is returned. If you want the avatar that a webhook has displayed, consider <a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.display_avatar" title="discord.SyncWebhook.display_avatar"><code>display_avatar</code></a>.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

Optional\[<a href="#discord.Asset" title="discord.Asset"><code>Asset</code></a>]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*channel<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.channel" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The channel this webhook belongs to.

If this is a partial webhook, then this will always return <code>None</code>.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

Optional\[Union\[<a href="#discord.ForumChannel" title="discord.ForumChannel"><code>ForumChannel</code></a>, <a href="#discord.VoiceChannel" title="discord.VoiceChannel"><code>VoiceChannel</code></a>, <a href="#discord.TextChannel" title="discord.TextChannel"><code>TextChannel</code></a>]]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*created_at<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.created_at" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Returns the webhook’s creation time in UTC.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>datetime.datetime</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*default_avatar<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.default_avatar" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Returns the default avatar.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.Asset" title="discord.Asset"><code>Asset</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*display_avatar<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.display_avatar" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Returns the webhook’s display avatar.

This is either webhook’s default avatar or uploaded avatar.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.Asset" title="discord.Asset"><code>Asset</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*property*guild<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.guild" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

The guild this webhook belongs to.

If this is a partial webhook, then this will always return <code>None</code>.

Optional\[<a href="#discord.Guild" title="discord.Guild"><code>Guild</code></a>]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>is_authenticated()<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.is_authenticated" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>: Whether the webhook is authenticated with a bot token.

New in version 2.0.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>is_partial()<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.is_partial" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>: Whether the webhook is a “partial” webhook.

New in version 2.0.

</dd></dl><dl><dt>send(*content=...*, ***, *username=...*, *avatar_url=...*, *tts=False*, *file=...*, *files=...*, *embed=...*, *embeds=...*, *allowed_mentions=...*, *thread=...*, *thread_name=...*, *wait=False*, *suppress_embeds=False*, *silent=False*, *applied_tags=...*, *poll=...*, *view=...*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.send" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Sends a message using the webhook.

The content must be a type that can convert to a string through <code>str(content)</code>.

To upload a single file, the <code>file</code> parameter should be used with a single <a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a> object.

If the <code>embed</code> parameter is provided, it must be of type <a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a> and it must be a rich embed type. You cannot mix the <code>embed</code> parameter with the <code>embeds</code> parameter, which must be a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#list" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>list</code></a> of <a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a> objects to send.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **content** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The content of the message to send.
- **wait** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether the server should wait before sending a response. This essentially means that the return type of this function changes from <code>None</code> to a <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage" title="discord.WebhookMessage"><code>WebhookMessage</code></a> if set to <code>True</code>.
- **username** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The username to send with this message. If no username is provided then the default username for the webhook is used.
- **avatar\_url** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The avatar URL to send with this message. If no avatar URL is provided then the default avatar for the webhook is used. If this is not a string then it is explicitly cast using <code>str</code>.
- **tts** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Indicates if the message should be sent using text-to-speech.
- **file** (<a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>) – The file to upload. This cannot be mixed with <code>files</code> parameter.
- **files** (List\[<a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>]) – A list of files to send with the content. This cannot be mixed with the <code>file</code> parameter.
- **embed** (<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>) – The rich embed for the content to send. This cannot be mixed with <code>embeds</code> parameter.
- **embeds** (List\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – A list of embeds to send with the content. Maximum of 10. This cannot be mixed with the <code>embed</code> parameter.
- **allowed\_mentions** (<a href="#discord.AllowedMentions" title="discord.AllowedMentions"><code>AllowedMentions</code></a>) –

  Controls the mentions being processed in this message.

  New in version 1.4.
- **thread** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) –

  The thread to send this message to.

  New in version 2.0.
- **thread\_name** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) –

  The thread name to create with this webhook if the webhook belongs to a <a href="#discord.ForumChannel" title="discord.ForumChannel"><code>ForumChannel</code></a>. Note that this is mutually exclusive with the <code>thread</code> parameter, as this will create a new thread with the given name.

  New in version 2.0.
- **suppress\_embeds** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

  Whether to suppress embeds for the message. This sends the message without any embeds if set to <code>True</code>.

  New in version 2.0.
- **silent** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

  Whether to suppress push and desktop notifications for the message. This will increment the mention counter in the UI, but will not actually send a notification.

  New in version 2.2.
- **poll** (<a href="#discord.Poll" title="discord.Poll"><code>Poll</code></a>) –

  The poll to send with this message.

  Warning

  When sending a Poll via webhook, you cannot manually end it.

  New in version 2.4.
- **view** (Union\[<a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.View" title="discord.ui.View"><code>View</code></a>, <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>LayoutView</code></a>]) –

  The view to send with the message. This can only have non-interactible items, which do not require a state to be attached to it.

  If you want to send a view with any component attached to it, check <a href="#discord.Webhook.send" title="discord.Webhook.send"><code>Webhook.send()</code></a>.

  New in version 2.5.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Sending the message failed.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – This webhook was not found.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – The authorization token for the webhook is incorrect.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – You specified both <code>embed</code> and <code>embeds</code> or <code>file</code> and <code>files</code> or <code>thread</code> and <code>thread_name</code>.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The length of <code>embeds</code> was invalid, there was no token associated with this webhook or you tried to send a view with components other than URL buttons.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

If <code>wait</code> is <code>True</code> then the message that was sent, otherwise <code>None</code>.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

Optional\[<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage"><code>SyncWebhookMessage</code></a>]

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>fetch_message(*id*, */*, ***, *thread=...*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.fetch_message" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Retrieves a single <a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage"><code>SyncWebhookMessage</code></a> owned by this webhook.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **id** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The message ID to look for.
- **thread** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) – The thread to look in.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – The specified message was not found.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have the permissions required to get a message.
- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Retrieving the message failed.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – There was no token associated with this webhook.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The message asked for.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage"><code>SyncWebhookMessage</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>edit_message(*message_id*, ***, *content=...*, *embeds=...*, *embed=...*, *attachments=...*, *view=...*, *allowed_mentions=None*, *thread=...*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.edit_message" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Edits a message owned by this webhook.

This is a lower level interface to <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.edit" title="discord.WebhookMessage.edit"><code>WebhookMessage.edit()</code></a> in case you only have an ID.

New in version 1.6.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **message\_id** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The message ID to edit.
- **content** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The content to edit the message with or <code>None</code> to clear it.
- **embeds** (List\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – A list of embeds to edit the message with.
- **embed** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – The embed to edit the message with. <code>None</code> suppresses the embeds. This should not be mixed with the <code>embeds</code> parameter.
- **attachments** (List\[Union\[<a href="#discord.Attachment" title="discord.Attachment"><code>Attachment</code></a>, <a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>]]) –

  A list of attachments to keep in the message as well as new files to upload. If <code>[]</code> is passed then all attachments are removed.

  New in version 2.0.
- **view** (Optional\[Union\[<a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.View" title="discord.ui.View"><code>View</code></a>, <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>LayoutView</code></a>]]) –

  The updated view to update this message with. This can only have non-interactible items, which do not require a state to be attached to it. If <code>None</code> is passed then the view is removed.

  If you want to edit a webhook message with any component attached to it, check <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.edit" title="discord.WebhookMessage.edit"><code>WebhookMessage.edit()</code></a>.

  Note

  To update the message to add a <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>LayoutView</code></a>, you must explicitly set the <code>content</code>, <code>embed</code>, <code>embeds</code>, and <code>attachments</code> parameters to either <code>None</code> or an empty array, as appropriate.

  New in version 2.6.
- **allowed\_mentions** (<a href="#discord.AllowedMentions" title="discord.AllowedMentions"><code>AllowedMentions</code></a>) – Controls the mentions being processed in this message. See <a href="#discord.abc.Messageable.send" title="discord.abc.Messageable.send"><code>abc.Messageable.send()</code></a> for more information.
- **thread** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) –

  The thread the webhook message belongs to.

  New in version 2.0.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Editing the message failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – Edited a message that is not yours.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – You specified both <code>embed</code> and <code>embeds</code>
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The length of <code>embeds</code> was invalid or there was no token associated with this webhook.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>delete_message(*message_id*, */*, ***, *thread=...*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhook.delete_message" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Deletes a message owned by this webhook.

This is a lower level interface to <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.delete" title="discord.WebhookMessage.delete"><code>WebhookMessage.delete()</code></a> in case you only have an ID.

New in version 1.6.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **message\_id** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The message ID to delete.
- **thread** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) –

  The thread the webhook message belongs to.

  New in version 2.0.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Deleting the message failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – Deleted a message that is not yours.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – This webhook does not have a token associated with it.

</dd></dl></dd>

Methods

<dl><dt>*class*discord.SyncWebhookMessage<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Represents a message sent from your webhook.

This allows you to edit or delete a message sent by your webhook.

This inherits from <a href="#discord.Message" title="discord.Message"><code>discord.Message</code></a> with changes to <a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage.edit" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage.edit"><code>edit()</code></a> and <a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage.delete" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage.delete"><code>delete()</code></a> to work.

New in version 2.0.

<dl><dt>edit(***, *content=...*, *embeds=...*, *embed=...*, *attachments=...*, *allowed_mentions=None*, *view=...*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage.edit" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Edits the message.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>TypeError</code></a> or <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **content** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The content to edit the message with or <code>None</code> to clear it.
- **embeds** (List\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – A list of embeds to edit the message with.
- **embed** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.Embed" title="discord.Embed"><code>Embed</code></a>]) – The embed to edit the message with. <code>None</code> suppresses the embeds. This should not be mixed with the <code>embeds</code> parameter.
- **attachments** (List\[Union\[<a href="#discord.Attachment" title="discord.Attachment"><code>Attachment</code></a>, <a href="#discord.File" title="discord.File"><code>File</code></a>]]) –

  A list of attachments to keep in the message as well as new files to upload. If <code>[]</code> is passed then all attachments are removed.

  Note

  New files will always appear after current attachments.

  New in version 2.0.
- **allowed\_mentions** (<a href="#discord.AllowedMentions" title="discord.AllowedMentions"><code>AllowedMentions</code></a>) – Controls the mentions being processed in this message. See <a href="#discord.abc.Messageable.send" title="discord.abc.Messageable.send"><code>abc.Messageable.send()</code></a> for more information.
- **view** (Union\[<a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.View" title="discord.ui.View"><code>discord.ui.View</code></a>, <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>discord.ui.LayoutView</code></a>]) –

  The updated view to update this message with. This can only have non-interactible items, which do not require a state to be attached to it. If <code>None</code> is passed then the view is removed.

  If you want to edit a webhook message with any component attached to it, check <a href="#discord.WebhookMessage.edit" title="discord.WebhookMessage.edit"><code>WebhookMessage.edit()</code></a>.

  Note

  To update the message to add a <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.ui.LayoutView" title="discord.ui.LayoutView"><code>LayoutView</code></a>, you must explicitly set the <code>content</code>, <code>embed</code>, <code>embeds</code>, and <code>attachments</code> parameters to either <code>None</code> or an empty array, as appropriate.

  New in version 2.7.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Editing the message failed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – Edited a message that is not yours.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – You specified both <code>embed</code> and <code>embeds</code>.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The length of <code>embeds</code> was invalid or there was no token associated with this webhook.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The newly edited message.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage"><code>SyncWebhookMessage</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>add_files(**files*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage.add_files" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>

- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – Tried to edit a message that isn’t yours.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>

The newly edited message.

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage"><code>SyncWebhookMessage</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>

The newly edited message.

<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage" title="discord.SyncWebhookMessage"><code>SyncWebhookMessage</code></a>

</dl><dl><dt>delete(***, *delay=None*)<a href="#discord.SyncWebhookMessage.delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Deletes the message.

**delay** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#float" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>float</code></a>]) – If provided, the number of seconds to wait before deleting the message. This blocks the thread.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>

## Abstract Base Classes ¶

An [abstract base class](https://docs.python.org/3/glossary.html#term-abstract-base-class "(in Python v3.14)") (also known as an `abc`) is a class that models can inherit to get their behaviour. **Abstract base classes should not be instantiated**. They are mainly there for usage with [`isinstance()`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#isinstance "(in Python v3.14)") and [`issubclass()`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#issubclass "(in Python v3.14)").

This library has a module related to abstract base classes, in which all the ABCs are subclasses of [`typing.Protocol`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Protocol "(in Python v3.14)").

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>permissions_for(*obj*, */*)<a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel.permissions_for" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

Handles permission resolution for the <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a>.

This function takes into consideration the following cases:

- Guild owner
- Guild roles
- Channel overrides
- Member overrides
- Implicit permissions
- Member timeout
- User installed app

If a <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a> is passed, then it checks the permissions someone with that role would have, which is essentially:

- The default role permissions
- The permissions of the role used as a parameter
- The default role permission overwrites
- The permission overwrites of the role used as a parameter

Changed in version 2.0: The object passed in can now be a role object.

Changed in version 2.0: <code>obj</code> parameter is now positional-only.

Changed in version 2.4: User installed apps are now taken into account. The permissions returned for a user installed app mirrors the permissions Discord returns in <a href="https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactions/api.html#discord.Interaction.app_permissions" title="discord.Interaction.app_permissions"><code>app_permissions</code></a>, though it is recommended to use that attribute instead.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

**obj** (Union\[<a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a>]) – The object to resolve permissions for. This could be either a member or a role. If it’s a role then member overwrites are not computed.

</dd><dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>

The resolved permissions for the member or role.

</dd><dt>Return type</dt>
<dd>

<a href="#discord.Permissions" title="discord.Permissions"><code>Permissions</code></a>

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* delete(***, *reason=None*)<a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel.delete" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Deletes the channel.

You must have <a href="#discord.Permissions.manage_channels" title="discord.Permissions.manage_channels"><code>manage_channels</code></a> to do this.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

**reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The reason for deleting this channel. Shows up on the audit log.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have proper permissions to delete the channel.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – The channel was not found or was already deleted.
- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Deleting the channel failed.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* set_permissions(*target*, ***, *overwrite=see - below*, *reason=None*, ***permissions*)<a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel.set_permissions" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Sets the channel specific permission overwrites for a target in the channel.

The <code>target</code> parameter should either be a <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a> or a <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a> that belongs to guild.

The <code>overwrite</code> parameter, if given, must either be <code>None</code> or <a href="#discord.PermissionOverwrite" title="discord.PermissionOverwrite"><code>PermissionOverwrite</code></a>. For convenience, you can pass in keyword arguments denoting <a href="#discord.Permissions" title="discord.Permissions"><code>Permissions</code></a> attributes. If this is done, then you cannot mix the keyword arguments with the <code>overwrite</code> parameter.

If the <code>overwrite</code> parameter is <code>None</code>, then the permission overwrites are deleted.

You must have <a href="#discord.Permissions.manage_roles" title="discord.Permissions.manage_roles"><code>manage_roles</code></a> to do this.

Note

This method *replaces* the old overwrites with the ones given.

Examples

Setting allow and deny:

```
await message.channel.set_permissions(message.author, read_messages=True,
                                                      send_messages=False)

```

Deleting overwrites

```
await channel.set_permissions(member, overwrite=None)

```

Using <a href="#discord.PermissionOverwrite" title="discord.PermissionOverwrite"><code>PermissionOverwrite</code></a>

```
overwrite = discord.PermissionOverwrite()
overwrite.send_messages = False
overwrite.read_messages = True
await channel.set_permissions(member, overwrite=overwrite)

```

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>TypeError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **target** (Union\[<a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>, <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a>]) – The member or role to overwrite permissions for.
- **overwrite** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.PermissionOverwrite" title="discord.PermissionOverwrite"><code>PermissionOverwrite</code></a>]) – The permissions to allow and deny to the target, or <code>None</code> to delete the overwrite.
- **\*\*permissions** – A keyword argument list of permissions to set for ease of use. Cannot be mixed with <code>overwrite</code>.
- **reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The reason for doing this action. Shows up on the audit log.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have permissions to edit channel specific permissions.
- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Editing channel specific permissions failed.
- <a href="#discord.NotFound" title="discord.NotFound">**NotFound**</a> – The role or member being edited is not part of the guild.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – The <code>overwrite</code> parameter was invalid or the target type was not <a href="#discord.Role" title="discord.Role"><code>Role</code></a> or <a href="#discord.Member" title="discord.Member"><code>Member</code></a>.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – The <code>overwrite</code> parameter and <code>positions</code> parameters were both unset.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* clone(***, *name=None*, *category=None*, *reason=None*)<a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel.clone" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Clones this channel. This creates a channel with the same properties as this channel.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* move(***kwargs*)<a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel.move" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

A rich interface to help move a channel relative to other channels.

If exact position movement is required, <code>edit</code> should be used instead.

You must have <a href="#discord.Permissions.manage_channels" title="discord.Permissions.manage_channels"><code>manage_channels</code></a> to do this.

Note

Voice channels will always be sorted below text channels. This is a Discord limitation.

New in version 1.7.

Changed in version 2.0: This function will now raise <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>TypeError</code></a> or <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>ValueError</code></a> instead of <code>InvalidArgument</code>.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **beginning** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to move the channel to the beginning of the channel list (or category if given). This is mutually exclusive with <code>end</code>, <code>before</code>, and <code>after</code>.
- **end** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to move the channel to the end of the channel list (or category if given). This is mutually exclusive with <code>beginning</code>, <code>before</code>, and <code>after</code>.
- **before** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) – Whether to move the channel before the given channel. This is mutually exclusive with <code>beginning</code>, <code>end</code>, and <code>after</code>.
- **after** (<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>) – Whether to move the channel after the given channel. This is mutually exclusive with <code>beginning</code>, <code>end</code>, and <code>before</code>.
- **offset** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – The number of channels to offset the move by. For example, an offset of <code>2</code> with <code>beginning=True</code> would move it 2 after the beginning. A positive number moves it below while a negative number moves it above. Note that this number is relative and computed after the <code>beginning</code>, <code>end</code>, <code>before</code>, and <code>after</code> parameters.
- **category** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.abc.Snowflake" title="discord.abc.Snowflake"><code>Snowflake</code></a>]) – The category to move this channel under. If <code>None</code> is given then it moves it out of the category. This parameter is ignored if moving a category channel.
- **sync\_permissions** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Whether to sync the permissions with the category (if given).
- **reason** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>) – The reason for the move.

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
<dd>

- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ValueError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**ValueError**</a> – An invalid position was given.
- <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#TypeError" title="(in Python v3.14)">**TypeError**</a> – A bad mix of arguments were passed.
- <a href="#discord.Forbidden" title="discord.Forbidden">**Forbidden**</a> – You do not have permissions to move the channel.
- <a href="#discord.HTTPException" title="discord.HTTPException">**HTTPException**</a> – Moving the channel failed.

</dd></dl></dd>
</dl><dl><dt>*await* create_invite(***, *reason=None*, *max_age=0*, *max_uses=0*, *temporary=False*, *unique=True*, *target_type=None*, *target_user=None*, *target_application_id=None*, *guest=False*)<a href="#discord.abc.GuildChannel.create_invite" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
<dd>

This function is a <a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#coroutine">*coroutine*</a>.

Creates an instant invite from a text or voice channel.

You must have <a href="#discord.Permissions.create_instant_invite" title="discord.Permissions.create_instant_invite"><code>create_instant_invite</code></a> to do this.

<dl><dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd>

- **max\_age** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – How long the invite should last in seconds. If it’s 0 then the invite doesn’t expire. Defaults to <code>0</code>.
- **max\_uses** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>int</code></a>) – How many uses the invite could be used for. If it’s 0 then there are unlimited uses. Defaults to <code>0</code>.
- **temporary** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Denotes that the invite grants temporary membership (i.e. they get kicked after they disconnect). Defaults to <code>False</code>.
- **unique** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) – Indicates if a unique invite URL should be created. Defaults to True. If this is set to <code>False</code> then it will return a previously created invite.
- **reason** (Optional\[<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>str</code></a>]) – The reason for creating this invite. Shows up on the audit log.
- **target\_type** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.InviteTarget" title="discord.InviteTarget"><code>InviteTarget</code></a>]) –

- **target\_user** (Optional\[<a href="#discord.abc.User" title="discord.abc.User"><code>User</code></a>]) –

  New in version 2.0.
- **guest** (<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code>bool</code></a>) –

</dd><dt>Raises</dt>
